comparison.objective: Denest two trays and park both upright in assigned bays.
comparison.physical_skill: Grasp tabs, lift the inner tray clear before lateral motion, and place both trays.
comparison.success_condition: Released stable trays in bays within 20 mm, tilt below 8 degrees, yaw error below 10 degrees, held 2 seconds.
comparison.reason: This is constrained extraction and placement of nested containers, with no tuning, tooling, locking, or dynamic-response objective.
